name: @kiligzzz/dsh-agent-dispatch
description: User-defined agents with automatic routing for DeepSeek Harness: fixed-persona continuable subagents, per-agent model routes with failover, dispatch/followup/list/squad/import/upsert tools, and a routing prompt section. No built-in agents — create your own via the panel, import from skills, or upsert programmatically without restart. Dual-face dsh plugin (host + browser half), no DSH source changes.
author: kiligzzz <zyfkilig@gmail.com>
